description: Recent Activity — create ActivityStorage class using shared_preferences, add a Recent Activity section to home_screen.dart (between Quick Actions and Recent Questions), call ActivityStorage.addResourceView in course_detail_screen.dart when a resource is tapped, call ActivityStorage.addQuestionView in question_detail_screen.dart when data loads. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Create `web_app/lib/core/storage/activity_storage.dart`. Import shared_preferences, dart:convert. Class ActivityStorage with all-static methods: addResourceView({required String id, required String title, required String type}) — reads 'recent_resources' JSON list from SharedPreferences, prepends { 'id': id, 'title': title, 'type': type, 'itemType': 'resource', 'timestamp': DateTime.now().toIso8601String() }, keeps last 20 entries, saves back; addQuestionView({required String id, required String title}) — same pattern with 'recent_questions' key, item has itemType: 'question'; getRecentActivity() — reads both lists, merges them, sorts descending by timestamp (DateTime.parse), takes the first 8 items, returns List<Map<String,dynamic>>. Helper _readList(SharedPreferences prefs, String key) and _saveList(SharedPreferences prefs, String key, List list) private statics for DRY code.

2. Add a recentActivityProvider to `web_app/lib/presentation/screens/home/home_screen.dart`: final recentActivityProvider = FutureProvider.autoDispose<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>((ref) async { return ActivityStorage.getRecentActivity(); }); Add import for activity_storage.dart.

3. Add the 'Recent Activity' section to the HomeScreen build method in `web_app/lib/presentation/screens/home/home_screen.dart`. Insert it after the Quick Actions block and before the Recent Questions block. Structure: _SectionHeader(title: 'Recent Activity', onViewAll: noop — use an empty lambda), then recentActivityProvider.when(loading: ..., error: ..., data: (items) { if items.isEmpty show a small _EmptyState; else build a Column of items.take(3) each as a Card/ListTile: leading icon (Icons.description_outlined for 'resource', Icons.forum_outlined for 'question'), title is the item title, subtitle is item['type'] (resource type label) or 'Question' for question type, onTap navigates to '/resources' for resource or '/community/${item['id']}' for question using context.go. Use AppColors for icon colors (AppColors.primary for resource, AppColors.cyan for question).

4. Update `web_app/lib/presentation/screens/courses/course_detail_screen.dart`. In _ResourceTile.build, inside the trailing IconButton.onPressed that calls launchUrl, also call ActivityStorage.addResourceView(id: resource['id']?.toString() ?? '', title: title, type: type ?? 'other') BEFORE the launchUrl call. Since _ResourceTile is a StatelessWidget, use a direct call (no ref needed — ActivityStorage is all-static). Add import for activity_storage.dart.

5. Update `web_app/lib/presentation/screens/community/question_detail_screen.dart`. In _QuestionDetailBody.build, extract the question title from the question map. After the title is known (in the data: callback of the questionAsync.when in QuestionDetailScreen.build), call ActivityStorage.addQuestionView(id: widget.questionId, title: title). The cleanest place: inside the data: branch of the questionAsync.when in _QuestionDetailScreenState.build, before building _QuestionDetailBody — call ActivityStorage.addQuestionView as a fire-and-forget (don't await, just call the future). Add import for activity_storage.dart.
6. Verify: flutter analyze in web_app (no issues).
acceptance_criteria: web_app/lib/core/storage/activity_storage.dart exists with addResourceView, addQuestionView, getRecentActivity static methods
getRecentActivity returns combined list sorted by timestamp desc, max 8 items
home_screen.dart shows a 'Recent Activity' section between Quick Actions and Recent Questions, with up to 3 items
Tapping a resource card in course_detail_screen.dart records it via ActivityStorage.addResourceView
Opening a question detail screen records it via ActivityStorage.addQuestionView
flutter analyze in web_app reports no issues
findings: All 5 implementation steps complete. (1) Created web_app/lib/core/storage/activity_storage.dart — ActivityStorage with static addResourceView/addQuestionView (prepend, cap at 20 per list, JSON via SharedPreferences keys 'recent_resources'/'recent_questions') and getRecentActivity (merge both, sort by timestamp desc, return max 8) plus private _readList/_saveList helpers. (2) Added recentActivityProvider (FutureProvider.autoDispose<List<Map<String,dynamic>>>) and import to home_screen.dart. (3) Added 'Recent Activity' section to HomeScreen.build AFTER Quick Actions and BEFORE Recent Questions — _SectionHeader with noop onViewAll, recentActivityProvider.when with loading skeleton, error _ErrorBanner, and data showing up to 3 Card/ListTile items; leading icon Icons.description_outlined in AppColors.primary for resources, Icons.forum_outlined in AppColors.cyan for questions; subtitle is item['type'] for resources or 'Question' for questions; onTap uses context.go to '/resources' (resource) or '/community/${id}' (question); empty state when no items. (4) course_detail_screen.dart _ResourceTile.build trailing IconButton.onPressed now calls ActivityStorage.addResourceView(id, title, type ?? 'other') fire-and-forget BEFORE launchUrl; import added. (5) question_detail_screen.dart _QuestionDetailScreenState.build data: branch now calls ActivityStorage.addQuestionView(id: widget.questionId, title: question['title']) fire-and-forget BEFORE building _QuestionDetailBody; import added. Verification: flutter analyze in web_app reports 359 issues, all pre-existing and unrelated to this feature (verified by stashing these changes — baseline is also exactly 359 issues; none of the 4 changed files appear in the analyzer output). FEAT-003 introduces zero new analyzer issues. No product decisions were required; implementation followed the spec exactly.
